entity_types.entity_description: Reusable LLM4AD algorithm memory cards extracted from user input, task execution, evolution results, failures, and project guidance.
entity_types.entity_instruction: Extract only information that is useful for future LLM4AD algorithm evolution. Each extracted memory entity must include exactly one substantive card property using one of: good_algorithm, error_reflection, domain_knowledge, general_insight. For algorithm execution observations, the substantive card must name a concrete technical mechanism, the condition where it applies or fails, the evidence from score/metrics/error/generation/code when available, and the future action to reuse or avoid. Do not create a memory that only says performance improved, exploration increased, results got better, or the algorithm was effective without naming the mechanism and evidence. The tags property is optional user-facing metadata: generate it only when concise grouping labels can be inferred naturally from the same source message, and never skip an otherwise useful memory card because tags are uncertain. Do not create personal profile, conversation episode, organization, place, or other unrelated entities. If the input is temporary chat, credentials, or has no reusable value for algorithm evolution, do not extract a memory.

static_property.name: A short stable title for this memory card, preferably describing the algorithm, error, domain, or insight.

good_algorithm.desc: Successful algorithm design, operator choice, parameter range, search strategy, initialization method, repair method, or empirical pattern that should be reused. Include the concrete mechanism, applicable condition, evidence such as score/metric/generation/code clue when available, and the future reuse guidance. The value is the LLM4AD MemoryCard.content for type=good_algorithm.
good_algorithm.example: For clustered TSP instances, nearest-neighbor construction followed by bounded 2-opt repair reduced tour length versus the parent baseline; keep the 2-opt neighborhood capped to avoid excessive runtime.

error_reflection.desc: Failure lesson, runtime error, invalid assumption, unstable parameter, implementation pitfall, or debugging reflection that should help avoid repeated mistakes. Include the failing mechanism, trigger condition, evidence such as score/error/metric/generation/code clue when available, and the future avoidance guidance. The value is the LLM4AD MemoryCard.content for type=error_reflection.
error_reflection.example: Cluster-first TSP construction optimized intra-cluster routes but left expensive inter-cluster jumps, producing poor tour length; future designs must explicitly optimize cluster connection order.

domain_knowledge.desc: Task or domain facts, constraints, objective details, benchmark characteristics, data assumptions, or project-specific requirements. The value is the LLM4AD MemoryCard.content for type=domain_knowledge.
domain_knowledge.example: In this project, solution stability and interpretability are more important than small gains from complex black-box heuristics.

general_insight.desc: General reusable insight, preference, heuristic, comparison, or planning guidance that does not clearly fit the other three memory types. The value is the LLM4AD MemoryCard.content for type=general_insight.
general_insight.example: When a heuristic has many interacting parameters, first tune one parameter group at a time and keep ablation notes for later runs.

tags.desc: Optional user-facing metadata for filtering, searching, and grouping memory cards. When the source message naturally supports it, generate a concise comma-separated list of 0-6 visible tags using stable technical, algorithm, domain, task, or lesson labels. Do not include dates, generic words, credentials, full sentences, or labels that are not grounded in the source message.
